SOAP Clinical Note

Subjective:
- Presenting complaints: 4-day history of sore throat (improving), runny nose with nasal congestion, new dry cough (since yesterday), night sweats, fatigue, mild exertional shortness of breath, intermittent generalized headaches, myalgia.
- Constitutional: Initial fever now resolving with OTC analgesics/antipyretics.
- No chest pain at rest; no ear pain/discharge, visual changes, photophobia, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, urinary or bowel disturbance.
- Past medical history: Denies chronic illnesses; “otherwise fit and well.”
- Past surgical history: Not documented.
- Medications: Paracetamol and Ibuprofen (dose/route/frequency not documented).
- Allergies: Denies medication allergies.
- Family history: Grandmother – type 2 diabetes mellitus; great-grandfather – eczema.
- Social history: Lives alone; works as an accountant; occasional cigar use at social/work events; occasional alcohol use; denies regular smoking.

Objective:
- No in-person examination performed during teleconsultation; vitals not obtained.
- No investigations performed or reviewed.

Assessment & Plan:

1. Viral upper respiratory tract infection / possible early influenza
   - Assessment: Likely viral URTI/early influenza given constellation of sore throat, congestion, dry cough, myalgia, low-grade fever, and absence of red-flag features.
   - Differential diagnosis: COVID-19, bacterial pharyngitis, sinusitis (less likely given clinical picture).
   - Investigations planned: None at this time; advised to monitor symptoms and seek review if they persist >7 days or worsen.
   - Treatment planned: Symptomatic care—rest, increased oral fluids, continue Paracetamol and Ibuprofen as needed (within recommended dosing limits).
   - Safety-net advice: Return earlier for high fever, worsening dyspnea, chest pain, or failure to improve within one week.

Quality checks:
● Missing but clinically expected: Vital signs, throat/oral cavity visualization, COVID-19 testing status, medication dose/route/frequency, full allergy review (non-drug), vaccination history (influenza/COVID-19).  
● Internal conflicts: None noted.  
● Transcript quality: Clear; occasional minor pauses but clinically comprehensible.
